tools.name: payability_verdict
tools.description:
Latest payability observation for one exact resource URL (path and query included), with the
    meaning of the verdict, remediation if it cannot be paid, and the per-network options seen.

tools.name: find_endpoints
tools.description:
Search the catalogue by host or URL substring. Returns up to `limit` endpoints with their latest
    verdict, plus the total match count. Use this first when you do not know the exact resource URL.
    Optional network filter (for example eip155:8453 or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp) and

tools.name: catalogue_stats
tools.description:
Size and health of the x402 catalogue as of the latest full scan: resources, hosts, verdict
    counts, and payable endpoints per network.

tools.name: host_summary
tools.description:
Summary for a host (no time series): first/last seen, current verdict mix, n_resources, total
    verdict changes, gone_since if absent from the latest full scan, and a small resources_sample.

tools.name: x401_status
tools.description: Current x401 emitter adoption across the scanned catalogue (from the daily watcher).

tools.name: drift_status
tools.description:
Verdict changes between the two latest full scans (catalogue wide, or for one host), plus the
    declared model drift watch.

tools.name: verify_signature
tools.description:
Offline EIP-191 verify of a signed nsgoods response. Identifies the service from the
    manifest (or the optional `service` arg), strips exactly that service's post-sign fields,
    canonicalises (JCS, both ASCII modes), recovers the signer and checks it against the
    published manifest signers.

tools.name: reports
tools.description: Published weekly payability reports (from the signed manifest).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "verify_signature" is 1399 chars, far longer than this server's median (163). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_endpoints, verify_signature · Public sink: verify_signature.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_endpoints, verify_signature · Public sink: verify_signature

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_endpoints" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
